metadata.name: act_presale
metadata.description: Aretia Finance -- ACT public presale. Hand-authored against programs/act-presale/programs/act-presale/src/lib.rs, since no Anchor CLI was available in the environment this program was built in to auto-generate this file via `anchor build`. Discriminators are computed programmatically (sha256("global:<name>")[0..8] / sha256("account:<name>")[0..8]), matching Anchor's own convention exactly, not hand-typed. Verify against the source before trusting this for anything consequential. Devnet-verified only; not yet deployed to mainnet.

instructions.name: initialize_presale
docs: One-time setup. Creates the config PDA and the ACT vault ATA. Does not move any tokens or register payment currencies -- see initialize_payment_currency for that.

accounts.name: treasury_act_account
docs: Destination for unsold ACT via sweep_unsold_act; not touched by this instruction.

accounts.name: treasury_sol_account
docs: Destination for swept SOL contributions on a successful finalize; not touched by this instruction.

instructions.name: initialize_payment_currency
docs: Authority-gated. Registers one accepted payment currency (USDC or USDT) at slot `index` (0 or 1) and creates its vault ATA. Called twice, once per currency -- split from initialize_presale because folding all three `init` constraints into one instruction overflowed the SBF VM's 4096-byte stack frame.

accounts.name: treasury_payment_account
docs: Destination for this currency's swept proceeds on a successful finalize; not touched by this instruction.

instructions.name: fund_act_reserve
docs: Authority-gated. Tops up the ACT vault vesting claims are paid from. Uses balance-delta accounting, so the recorded amount is net of this transfer's own fee.

instructions.name: buy
docs: Public. Buys ACT with `payment_amount` of whichever accepted currency (USDC or USDT) the passed payment_mint/payment_vault pair identifies. Funds are escrowed, not swept, until finalize.

accounts.name: payment_mint
docs: Must be one of config.accepted_mints; checked at runtime, not a static constraint, since either of two mints is valid here.

instructions.name: buy_with_sol
docs: Public. Buys ACT with native SOL, priced against the live Pyth SOL/USD feed the caller supplies via price_update. Same window/pause/min/max/hard-cap rules as buy, combined via USD-equivalent value.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: Escrows native SOL contributions directly as this PDA's own lamport balance.

accounts.name: price_update
docs: Pyth PriceUpdateV2 account for SOL/USD, posted by the caller (or their frontend) immediately before this instruction.

instructions.name: refund_sol
docs: Buyer-callable, only once status == Refunding. Returns exactly the lamports this wallet paid via buy_with_sol, regardless of how SOL/USD has moved since.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Only used for the has_one check on buyer_account; the real authority check is buyer being the transaction signer.

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Authority-gated. Callable once the sale window has ended, or earlier if the hard cap has been reached. Soft cap met: sweeps escrowed funds to treasury and starts vesting. Soft cap missed: moves to Refunding.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: Must equal config.accepted_mints[0], checked at runtime.

accounts.name: usdt_mint
docs: Must equal config.accepted_mints[1], checked at runtime.

instructions.name: refund
docs: Buyer-callable, only once status == Refunding. Refunds whatever this wallet contributed in the specific currency identified by payment_mint/payment_vault -- call once per currency actually used.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Buyer-callable, only once status == Finalized and TGE has occurred. Pays out whatever portion of this wallet's net allocation has vested and hasn't yet been claimed, grossed up so the buyer nets at least that amount after the mint's transfer fee.

instructions.name: sweep_unsold_act
docs: Authority-gated, callable any time after Finalized. Sends whatever ACT is left in the vault beyond what's still owed to remaining claimants back to the treasury.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Authority-gated circuit breaker. When paused, buy and buy_with_sol are rejected; claim and refund are never affected.

instructions.name: set_config_authority
docs: Hands config.authority to a new key, signed by the current authority.

errors.name: InvalidWindow
errors.msg: start_ts must be before end_ts.

errors.name: InvalidCaps
errors.msg: Soft cap must be greater than zero and no more than the hard cap.

errors.name: InvalidBuyLimits
errors.msg: min_buy_payment must be greater than zero and no more than max_buy_payment.

errors.name: InvalidVestingConfig
errors.msg: tge_bps must be 10000 or less, and vesting_duration_days must be greater than zero.

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: price_micro_payment_per_act must be greater than zero.

errors.name: DuplicatePaymentMint
errors.msg: USDC and USDT mints must be different accounts.

errors.name: InvalidCurrencyIndex
errors.msg: index must be 0 or 1.

errors.name: CurrencySlotAlreadySet
errors.msg: This currency slot has already been initialized.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero.

errors.name: PresaleNotActive
errors.msg: The presale is not currently active.

errors.name: PresalePaused
errors.msg: The presale is paused.

errors.name: PresaleNotStarted
errors.msg: The presale has not started yet.

errors.name: PresaleEnded
errors.msg: The presale has already ended.

errors.name: BelowMinBuy
errors.msg: This purchase is below the minimum first-time contribution.

errors.name: AboveMaxBuy
errors.msg: This purchase would exceed the maximum per-wallet contribution.

errors.name: HardCapExceeded
errors.msg: This purchase would exceed the presale hard cap.

errors.name: PresaleStillOpen
errors.msg: The presale window is still open and the hard cap has not been reached.

errors.name: NotRefunding
errors.msg: The presale is not in a refunding state.

errors.name: AlreadyRefunded
errors.msg: This wallet has already been refunded for this currency.

errors.name: NothingToRefund
errors.msg: There is nothing to refund for this wallet in this currency.

errors.name: NotFinalized
errors.msg: The presale has not been finalized.

errors.name: BeforeTge
errors.msg: The token generation event has not occurred yet.

errors.name: NothingClaimable
errors.msg: Nothing is currently claimable for this wallet.

errors.name: NothingToSweep
errors.msg: There is no unsold ACT to sweep.

errors.name: InvalidBuyerAccount
errors.msg: This buyer account does not belong to the signer.

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: Could not read the ACT mint's account data.

errors.name: MissingTransferFeeConfig
errors.msg: The ACT mint has no TransferFeeConfig extension.

errors.name: GrossUpShortfall
errors.msg: The grossed-up transfer amount still fell short of the net entitlement.

errors.name: UnsupportedPaymentMint
errors.msg: This mint is not an accepted presale payment currency.

errors.name: MismatchedPaymentVault
errors.msg: This vault does not match the configured vault for this payment mint.

errors.name: InvalidOraclePrice
errors.msg: The SOL/USD oracle price is invalid, stale, or for the wrong feed.

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow.

errors.name: InvalidNewAuthority
errors.msg: New authority cannot be the default (all-zero) pubkey.

fields.name: accepted_mints
docs: [USDC mint, USDT mint]

fields.name: accepted_vaults
docs: [USDC vault, USDT vault], index-matched to accepted_mints

fields.name: treasury_payment_accounts
docs: [treasury USDC account, treasury USDT account], index-matched

fields.name: price_micro_payment_per_act
docs: Price in the payment token's smallest unit per whole ACT (1e9 raw units).

fields.name: tge_ts
docs: Set by finalize; 0 until then.

fields.name: status
docs: 0=Active, 1=Finalized, 2=Refunding

fields.name: payment_contributed
docs: Index-matched to PresaleConfig.accepted_mints: [USDC, USDT]

fields.name: refunded
docs: Index-matched to PresaleConfig.accepted_mints
